title: Obedience
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 1 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Obedience is taught with its limit: a child never obeys anyone, even a known adult, who asks for something unsafe or secret; tell a trusted adult (SAFE).

skills.key_step: The child lists why children obey parents (Ephesians 6:1-3) and knows not to obey unsafe requests.
steps: Practise saying no to a stranger.

board.do: Wait for the child to say God says it is right.

misconceptions.ask: Mother says "come and eat". When should you come?
misconceptions.repair: Play a game: obey at once when called.

misconceptions.ask: Should you obey your father too?
A grown-up you do not know tells you to come with him. Should you obey?
misconceptions.repair: Say: we obey parents and teachers. If anyone asks for something unsafe or secret, say no and tell.

checks.question: Give a reason to obey parents.
checks.answer: God says it is right (it keeps us safe)

checks.question: A stranger says come with me. Do you obey?
